info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Fooddelivery Deliveries Status-v5-spec
info.description: The Food Delivery Status API enables users to access the current status of food deliveries within a specified timeframe. This endpoint allows consumers, such as delivery service operators and restaurant managers, to retrieve up-to-date information on delivery statuses, enhancing transparency and operational efficiency. By leveraging this API, businesses can monitor deliveries in real time, respond to customer inquiries effectively, and improve overall service satisfaction. It is particularly valuable for applications focusing on logistics, customer support, and operational analytics.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of deliveries.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to check the current status of deliveries. It provides detailed information on delivery progress and any potential issues that may have arisen during the delivery process.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the current status of deliveries. The client should provide the necessary information in JSON format to query the status effectively.

200.description: The request was successful and the current status of deliveries is returned.

ListFooddeliveryDeliveriesStatusRequest.title: Delivery Status Request Body
ListFooddeliveryDeliveriesStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the body of the request for retrieving the delivery status. It accepts a string value.

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Reference number associated with the delivery.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: Additional message related to the delivery status.

audit.description: Information regarding the audit trail for the delivery.

ListFooddeliveryDeliveriesStatusResponse.description: Response schema for the status of deliveries.

createdBy.description: The user who created the entry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the operation was performed automatically.

Audit.description: Schema representing audit information for deliveries.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the total time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. A lower value represents a quicker response time.
